subject: general
question: Banaras Hindu University was established in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1916.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Banaras Hindu University** was founded by **Pandit Madan Mohan Malviya, in 1916.**
 
• The university was formerly called **Central Hindu College**, which was founded by **Annie Besant in 1898.**
 
• She later** gifted the Central Hindu College **to **Pandit Madan Mohan Malviya** to get it converted into **Banaras Hindu University**.
 
• Banaras Hindu University was created under the** Parliamentary legislation - B.H.U. Act 1915.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Madan Mohan Malaviya **was an Indian scholar, educational reformer, and politician.
 
• He has been the** president of the Indian National Congress four times.**
 
• He is remembered for his role in the Indian independence movement.
 
• He is the founder of **Akhil Bharatiya Hindu Mahasabha.**
